# Ezekiel and the Dry Bones (Ezekiel 37:4)

## Emotional Focus
Praying when something feels impossible.

## Key KJV
“Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.” (Ezekiel 37:4)

## Gentle Retelling
God showed Ezekiel a valley of dry bones and told him to pray. Ezekiel obeyed and the bones came to life — God can do anything.

## Coloring Prompt
Ezekiel standing in a valley while bones begin to come together with new life.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Nothing is too hard for God when we pray.”
